subject: Kickoff: environment generation for robust web agents
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off the web-agents robustness effort. Base: our open-source environment-generation work for zero-shot compositional RL — instead of training agents on a fixed set of web tasks, we generate environments of growing compositional difficulty (on the MiniWoB stack) so agents generalize to task combinations they've never seen.

Product motivation: our form-filling agent prototypes are brittle on exactly the compositional cases — new page layouts recombining familiar widgets. Half plan: environment-generation pipeline running by end of May, curriculum-trained agents with zero-shot evals through June and July, and a go/no-go for the agents roadmap at the 8/10 review.

We'll also need a way to get human judgments on agent behavior beyond raw success rate — please scope that with the team.

Staffing and platform asks by early May?

Ulla
